questions.s:
A student suspects that substance Z is one of three possible pure substances P, R or S. Two chromatograms of the four substances are obtained using different solvents. The diagrams show the results.

What could Z be?

The apparatus shown is used to obtain a dry sample of carbon monoxide from a sample of the gas contaminated with sulfur dioxide gas.

Which shows the appropriate solutions in bottles 1 and 2 to collect a dry pure sample of carbon monoxide gas?
o: bottle 1: aqueous sodium hydroxide; bottle 2: concentrated sulfuric acid
bottle 1: aqueous sodium hydroxide; bottle 2: dilute sulfuric acid
bottle 1: dilute sulfuric acid; bottle 2: aqueous sodium hydroxide
bottle 1: dilute sulfuric acid; bottle 2: concentrated sulfuric acid

What can be deduced about naturally-occurring bromine from this information only?

Naturally occurring bromine exist as atoms.

Element Z forms a basic oxide when it reacts with oxygen.

What could X be?

What will be the effect of increasing the temperature but keeping pressure constant on the production of ammonia?
o: Ammonia is produced at an increased rate and its yield increases.
Ammonia is produced at an increased rate but its yield decreases.
Ammonia is produced at a decreased rate but its yield increases.

questions.s: Which statement about the manufacturing of ammonia by the Haber Process is not true?
o: A high temperature of 450 °C is used.
It is not possible to obtain 100 % yield of ammonia.

questions.s:

What are the ions present in the filtrate?

A series of tests was carried out on an aqueous solution of sodium carbonate and the results were recorded in a table.

Which test should be repeated because of an incorrect observation entered in the table?
o: test: add barium chloride solution; observation: white precipitate formed
test: add copper(II) chloride solution; observation: green precipitate formed
test: add potassium hydroxide solution; observation: white precipitate formed
test: add dilute sulfuric acid; observation: effervescence occurred

questions.s:

Which method will not slow down the rusting process of an iron nail?
o: Electroplate the iron nail with silver metal.
Coat the surface of the iron nail with paint.
Submerge the iron nail in oil.
Weld a piece of copper metal to the iron nail.

questions.s:
When a piece of calcium metal is added to dilute hydrochloric acid, the reaction is observed to be faster after 60 seconds from the start of the experiment than at the initial stage of the reaction.

What could be the possible explanation for this observation?
o: The concentration of the acid increases as the reaction progresses.
The particle size of the metal becomes smaller as the reaction progresses.
The reaction becomes faster as hydrochloric acid acts as a catalyst.
The reaction produces heat which increases the temperature of the acid.

questions.s:
Methane reacts very slowly with air at room temperature. However, methane ignites readily when palladium, a transition metal, is added to the methane-air mixture.

What is the purpose of palladium in the reaction?
o: It increases the enthalpy change of the reaction.
It increases the flammability of methane.
It lowers the activation energy of the reaction.
It lowers the energy level of the reactants.

questions.s:
The diagram shows how crude oil is separated into fractions.

Which statement about fractions X and Y is correct?
o: Fraction X burns more easily and has a lower boiling point than fraction Y.
Fraction X burns more easily and has a higher boiling point than fraction Y.
Fraction X burns less easily and has a lower boiling point than fraction Y.
Fraction X burns less easily and has a higher boiling point than fraction Y.

questions.s: Which statement best explains why bioethanol obtained from sugarcane plants is considered renewable?

Bioethanol is considered to be a carbon neutral biofuel.
Sugarcane plants can be regrown and replaced within a short period of time.
Sugarcane plants take in carbon dioxide during photosynthesis.
